# Draft:Authoritarian Republic of Blazeland

|official_website =
}}
The Authoritarian Republic of Blazeland, or Blazeland,  is a micronation which claims sovereignty over private property in Levin, New Zealand. It is not recognised by any country or government.
It was founded in March 2025 by Blaze Wakefield as a creative project, and maintains a flag, coat of arms, currency, and official documents. Blazeland currently has 6 citizens.
